recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, black-and-white close-up portrait of a man wearing a wide-brimmed hat, where the hat's shadow obscures the upper half of his face, leaving only one eye visible. The right side of the frame is a solid black void containing layered typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Shadow of the hat brim bisecting the facial features
High-key skin tones against absolute black negative space
Contrast between structured serif type and fluid script
Grainy film texture unifying the photographic and graphic elements
coreInvariants: Single eye visible through the shadow
Asymmetrical composition with subject on the left
Strict monochrome or desaturated sepia-toned palette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up, subject occupies the left 60% of the frame, cropped at the chin and top of the hat.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The single visible eye, positioned at the intersection of the shadow and light.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eye, moves down the bridge of the nose to the mouth, then shifts right to the typographic block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black negative space on the right side provides a canvas for text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black for shadows and background
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays for facial hair and skin texture
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast with zero saturation; high-key lighting.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Humanist serif and casual cursive script
letterConstructionRules: Serif text uses thick-and-thin stroke contrast with sharp, triangular serifs
Script text is monolinear and connected, mimicking natural handwriting
Tight letter spacing in the primary display text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'm' and 'g' in the serif font feature rounded, slightly flared terminals
The script 'y' and 'e' have long, sweeping tails

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed over the black negative space

composition.position: Directly below display text, aligned to the right edge

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a heavy, structured serif and a light, organic script.

candidateDirections.reason: Similar flared serifs and humanist proportions
Captures the casual, handwritten feel of the secondary text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white photo of a man in a cowboy hat, extreme close-up. The hat brim should cast a deep shadow over the top half of his face, leaving only one eye visible. The right side of the image should be pure black negative space. Apply a heavy film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of lowercase serif text in the bottom right, stacked and tightly spaced. Below that, add a line of light, handwritten script text aligned to the right edge of the serif block.

verificationChecks: Is the upper face obscured by a hard shadow?
Is the text restricted to the black negative space?
Is the primary text a bold serif in lowercase?

adjustableVariables: Angle of the hat brim shadow
Amount of facial hair on the subject
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or titles
Exact facial features of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the shadow doesn't completely hide both eyes.
Check that the script text is legible against the black background.
Verify that the grain doesn't muddy the sharp edges of the typography.
Confirm the subject is off-center to the left.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast portrait + Hat shadow mask + Stacked serif/script typography + Film grain
